name: the-forge
description: A curated suite for product management and productivity tools with deterministic Python data layer (forge-lib) and LLM reasoning layer. Commands simplified 60% from v1.

plugins.name: product-forge
plugins.description: Local-first product management with forge-lib delegation. Creates Initiative, Epic, Story, Intake, Checkpoint, Decision, and Release Note cards via CLI. Simplified commands (80-100 lines) focus on conversational workflow.

plugins.name: tasks-forge
plugins.description: Task management with sequential numbering (task-NNN.md) and status workflow. All file operations delegated to forge-lib. Query by status, priority, due date via index.json.

plugins.name: forge-memory
plugins.description: Organizational memory and context management with taxonomy support. Two-tier system with CLAUDE.md hot cache and memory/ directory for products, modules, systems, clients, teams, and integrations.

plugins.name: cognitive-forge
plugins.description: Multi-agent debate and exploration sessions with date-based filenames (YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md). Spawns specialized agents (Challenger, Decomposer, Evaluator, Explorer, Synthesizer) for parallel reasoning.

plugins.name: report-forge
plugins.description: Multi-agent report generation with 8 report types (executive-summary, technical-deep-dive, competitive-analysis, architecture-review, performance-analysis, incident-postmortem, quarterly-review, feasibility-study). Date-based filenames and status workflow.

plugins.name: rovo-forge
plugins.description: Interactive builders for Atlassian Rovo agents. Guides through Jira and Confluence agent configuration via adaptive interview. Outputs structured agent configs with copy-ready sections for Rovo Studio.
